decisions.rationale: This full PA CAN expression directly attests afflicted state of mind, and this clause has no separate SEMS noun. The complete nominal realization is therefore retained, unlike358 where explicit SEMS owns state separately.

The first GYI relates the words to their afflicted condition; English recasts that relation as spoken in an afflicted state. The unique local in is proposed as grammatical correspondence, with spoken/an outside, not as a claim that genitives universally mean in.
The first independent TSHIG directly attests words and owns the first definition. The later source TSHIG is singular spoken word in the alternative account.
The single explicit totalizer KUN supplies the first every. The later every in the alternative definition is an English restatement and receives no duplicated KUN.
The complete technical expression directly attests meaningless speech. Its exact glossary and explicit NGAG/KYAL PA members support the two complete member words inside this first parent.
NGAG directly attests speech, uniquely inside the first technical parent. It does not own the preceding independent words noun.
KYAL PA directly attests meaningless. The entire capital English word is selected; no interior less affix analysis is introduced.
The first emphatic NYID supplies really in the first definition. Complete reference eva and precisely/real candidates support this local emphasis; the glossary does not literally list really.

The first definitional YIN is recast as refers to. This local classification has a single English predicate; retain the whole grammatical phrase at d6 without a lexical source refer verb or a duplicated copula.
SDE PA directly attests groups/schools. Current source is clean SDE PA, distinct from the registered GNGSDE PA anomaly in326.

GZHAN qualifies these alternative interpretive groups, rendered capital Other. The mined a bodhisattva gloss is irrelevant; complete other/another reference material and the exact contrast support the local noun modifier.
The complete nominalized GSUM PO directly attests three. It refers to the preceding three speech actions and is not a count of all the examples that follow.

The complete demonstrative-case phrase supplies than those in this comparison. GZHAN PA owns other separately; LAS is not removed from DE and given an arbitrary second than. The order is transposed around the numeral between the two languages.

The other/else modifier is the lexical head of the exclusion construction, rendered tight other. Its mined other than candidate includes comparison support, but the explicit DE LAS phrase already owns than those; no overlapping English ownership is claimed.
The shorter second afflicted expression directly attests afflicted and modifies the alternative category. Type is expanded nominal framing, not part of a source lexical gloss to import.
The second independent TSHIG directly attests word, singular here. Spoken is English participial framing; do not borrow the NGAG inside the next separate technical title to supply it.
The second complete technical compound owns its separately quoted lowercase occurrence. The first title cannot be reused for this second source occurrence.
This NGAG supplies speech within the second parent only. Its unique member range is separate from both independent TSHIG nouns and the first title.
Second KYAL PA supplies the full lowercase meaningless member, without any English subword cut or duplicate first-parent range.
Second NYID supplies actually, the local emphatic clarification. Its distinct English occurrence is separated from the first NYID/really; no shared English emphasis is claimed.

The complete exemplifying formula is rendered like. Reference for example and the ensuing examples support this grammatical d6 correspondence; the mined present life gloss is unrelated and is not treated as evidence.
The complete DGE SLONG directly attests monk. Its full English word ends at the apostrophe delimiter; the article and possessive apostrophe-s stay outside, with no invented virtue/beggar members.

Keep complete inflected LOG PAS with improper. The exact full query is empty, but base LOG PA directly attests improper and the local qualification of livelihood supports this form; no final agentive-s split.

The complete livelihood noun directly attests livelihood. Its initial apostrophe is preserved in Wylie, and ACIP TSO versus Wylie TSHO is the established conversion rather than a current spelling correction.

KHA GSAG directly attests flattering and broader flattery for gain. Here the gain purpose is expanded around the verbal head; select only flattering and leave the supplied someone/purpose/gain wording unbanked rather than force an enormous compound or relocate BSLANGS from the next clause.

BYED PA directly includes engaging and supplies the action of doing this livelihood/flattery. English raises that verb before the livelihood phrase; in is its English complement support, not another source verb.
The first DANG links the flattery example to the next singing example and directly supports or else. Final source DANG instead continues into361 and has no further coordinator in this English row.
